def oracle(input):
    s = input[0]
    t = input[1]
    n = len(s)
    m = len(t)
    pref = [0] * m
    j = 0
    i = 0
    while i < n and j < m:
        if s[i] == t[j]:
            pref[j] = i
            j += 1
        i += 1
    suff = [0] * m
    j = m - 1
    i = n - 1
    while i >= 0 and j >= 0:
        if s[i] == t[j]:
            suff[j] = i
            j -= 1
        i -= 1
    ans = suff[0]
    if n - 1 - pref[m - 1] > ans:
        ans = n - 1 - pref[m - 1]
    k = 0
    while k + 1 < m:
        gap = suff[k + 1] - pref[k] - 1
        if gap > ans:
            ans = gap
        k += 1
    return ans

def oracle(input):
    n = input[0]
    a = input[1:1+n]
    pos = [0] * (n + 1)
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        pos[a[i]] = i + 1
        i += 1
    win = [False] * (n + 1)
    v = n
    while v >= 1:
        p = pos[v]
        step = v
        j = p - step
        ok = False
        while j >= 1:
            if a[j - 1] > v and not win[a[j - 1]]:
                ok = True
                break
            j -= step
        if not ok:
            j = p + step
            while j <= n:
                if a[j - 1] > v and not win[a[j - 1]]:
                    ok = True
                    break
                j += step
        win[v] = ok
        v -= 1
    res = ''
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        if win[a[i]]:
            res += 'A'
        else:
            res += 'B'
        i += 1
    return res

def oracle(input):
    MOD = 1000000007
    n = input[0]
    k = input[1]
    weights = input[2:2+n]
    c50 = 0
    c100 = 0
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        if weights[i] == 50:
            c50 += 1
        else:
            c100 += 1
        i += 1
    cap = k // 50
    if cap <= 0:
        return [-1, 0]
    max_units = 2 * c100 + c50
    fact = [1] * (n + 1)
    i = 1
    while i <= n:
        fact[i] = (fact[i-1] * i) % MOD
        i += 1
    invfact = [1] * (n + 1)
    invfact[n] = pow(fact[n], MOD - 2, MOD)
    i = n
    while i >= 1:
        invfact[i-1] = (invfact[i] * i) % MOD
        i -= 1
    def comb(a, b):
        if b < 0 or b > a:
            return 0
        return (((fact[a] * invfact[b]) % MOD) * invfact[a-b]) % MOD
    INF = 10 ** 9
    dist = []
    ways = []
    a = 0
    while a <= c50:
        rowd = []
        roww = []
        b = 0
        while b <= c100:
            rowd.append(INF)
            roww.append(0)
            b += 1
        dist.append(rowd)
        ways.append(roww)
        a += 1
    dist[c50][c100] = 0
    ways[c50][c100] = 1
    q = [(c50, c100)]
    head = 0
    while head < len(q):
        x = q[head][0]
        y = q[head][1]
        head += 1
        d = dist[x][y]
        side = d % 2
        if side == 0:
            i50 = 0
            while i50 <= x:
                max100 = y
                j100 = 0
                while j100 <= max100:
                    if i50 + j100 > 0 and i50 + 2 * j100 <= cap:
                        nx = x - i50
                        ny = y - j100
                        mult = (comb(x, i50) * comb(y, j100)) % MOD
                        nd = d + 1
                        if dist[nx][ny] > nd:
                            dist[nx][ny] = nd
                            ways[nx][ny] = (ways[x][y] * mult) % MOD
                            q.append((nx, ny))
                        elif dist[nx][ny] == nd:
                            ways[nx][ny] = (ways[nx][ny] + ways[x][y] * mult) % MOD
                    j100 += 1
                i50 += 1
        else:
            left50 = c50 - x
            left100 = c100 - y
            i50 = 0
            while i50 <= left50:
                j100 = 0
                while j100 <= left100:
                    if i50 + j100 > 0 and i50 + 2 * j100 <= cap:
                        nx = x + i50
                        ny = y + j100
                        mult = (comb(left50, i50) * comb(left100, j100)) % MOD
                        nd = d + 1
                        if dist[nx][ny] > nd:
                            dist[nx][ny] = nd
                            ways[nx][ny] = (ways[x][y] * mult) % MOD
                            q.append((nx, ny))
                        elif dist[nx][ny] == nd:
                            ways[nx][ny] = (ways[nx][ny] + ways[x][y] * mult) % MOD
                    j100 += 1
                i50 += 1
    if dist[0][0] >= INF:
        return [-1, 0]
    return [dist[0][0], ways[0][0] % MOD]

def oracle(input):
    n = input[0]
    m = input[1]
    r = input[2]
    switches = input[3]
    room_to_switches = []
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        room_to_switches.append([])
        i += 1
    s = 0
    while s < m:
        rooms = switches[s]
        j = 0
        while j < len(rooms):
            room = rooms[j] - 1
            room_to_switches[room].append(s)
            j += 1
        s += 1
    g = []
    i = 0
    while i < m:
        g.append([])
        i += 1
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        a = room_to_switches[i][0]
        b = room_to_switches[i][1]
        parity = 1 - r[i]
        g[a].append([b, parity])
        g[b].append([a, parity])
        i += 1
    color = []
    i = 0
    while i < m:
        color.append(-1)
        i += 1
    start = 0
    while start < m:
        if color[start] == -1:
            color[start] = 0
            stack = [start]
            while len(stack) > 0:
                v = stack.pop()
                edges = g[v]
                j = 0
                while j < len(edges):
                    to = edges[j][0]
                    p = edges[j][1]
                    want = color[v] ^ p
                    if color[to] == -1:
                        color[to] = want
                        stack.append(to)
                    else:
                        if color[to] != want:
                            return "NO"
                    j += 1
        start += 1
    return "YES"
